title: Are you going? Yes/no questions with megy

sections.title: Same words, question tune
sections.content: A yes/no question about going uses the same words as the statement; only the tune rises, and you write *?* at the end. *A parkba mész?* means “Are you going to the park?”, and the place stays in front of the verb. Answer with *Igen* or *Nem*, then say the full answer after a comma: *Igen, a parkba megyek.* or *Nem, a kávézóba megyek.* The same works for *van*: *Messze van a mozi?* – *Nem, közel van.*

items.english: Are you going to the office?
Yes, I am going to the office.

sections.content: After *Nem*, say something that fits: *Nem, a kávézóba megyek.* is a real answer to *A parkba mész?*, but *Nem, a parkba megyek.* contradicts itself. After *Igen*, repeat the same place. *Közel* means “near” and *messze* means “far”.
